content.title: Redesign Muslims Day with your own touch!
content.subtitle: Muslims Day UI/UX Hackathon 2026 is now underway.
content.body:
Have you ever come up with a new design idea while using the Muslims Day app? Have you ever thought, “This feature would be easier to use if it worked this way,” or “This screen could look a little better”?

Your valuable feedback, ideas, and love inspire us every day. Now, we want to bring you closer to our team, especially those who do more than point out problems and use their creativity to find solutions.

Our Goal and Vision

We are organising the Muslims Day UI/UX Hackathon 2026. Our goal is to make Muslims Day a world-class app that makes daily worship, Quran practice, and good habits easier and more enjoyable for Muslims around the world.

What Kind of Designers Are We Looking For?

We are looking for designers who do more than create beautiful screens. We want people who understand users' needs and design with care and thoughtful attention.

Let your designs reflect a human touch, creativity, and genuine care for users. You may use AI tools, but they should never replace your own ideas, experience, and design skills.

Why Should You Join This Hackathon?

Whether you are a student or an experienced designer, working alone or as part of a team, your participation matters to us. This is more than just a design competition. Your single idea could become part of millions of people's daily worship experience.

Exciting prizes and certificates await participants. But the greatest achievement will be using your skills to contribute to the well-being of the Ummah. Let's create something meaningful together.

  • 📅 Registration: From November 23, 2026

  • 📌 Design Submission Deadline: November 30, 2026

  • 🏆 Winner Announcement: December 6, 2026
